brief:
The Quincy Institute has raised questions about the rationale for sustained U.S. military funding to Israel, challenging the assumptions underlying decades of American support. The think tank's inquiry examines whether current aid levels serve stated U.S. strategic interests or warrant reassessment.

The question reflects broader debate within foreign policy circles over aid allocation, regional stability calculations, and the relationship between military assistance and diplomatic objectives in the Middle East.
title: Think tank questions continued U.S. military aid to Israel
